visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a blue athletic shirt and black baseball cap is jogging along a stone path in a bright, green park. He has a focused and slightly bewildered expression. The environment is filled with tall trees and manicured lawns under a clear, bright sky. (2) The scene cuts to another character, also played by the same man, wearing a long blonde wig and a tan cap. This character is also jogging and speaking with exaggerated facial expressions towards the camera. The lighting is natural and bright daylight throughout the outdoor setting. (3) The action shifts to a grassy field where a man with a white headband stands behind a thick tree trunk. He is playing a game of '123 Wooden Man' with the jogger. The camera cuts rapidly between the moderator turning around and the jogger freezing in place. (4) A high-intensity product showcase begins. The main character holds various cartons and tubs of 'Full Love Super Protein' drinks. Bright text overlays appear, and rapid cuts show the man eating yogurt with a spoon and drinking from the cartons in close-up shots. (5) The video returns to the park game. The moderator leans against the tree, looking skeptical, while the jogger intentionally moves to 'lose' the game. The final shot captures their comedic interaction in the wide, sunlit park background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a rhythmic electronic BGM featuring a synthesized beat and bright melodic textures. A male voice speaks in a conversational, comedic tone, alternating between his natural pitch and a forced higher register to represent different personas. Ambient outdoor environmental noise is virtually non-existent, indicating studio post-production. (2) A transition is marked by a sudden 'whoosh' SFX and a shift in vocal cadence as the moderator counts '1, 2, 3, Wooden Man' in Mandarin. The BGM tempo remains steady, providing a percussive backbone to the game sequence. The vocal intensity is moderate but engaging, with clear articulation. (3) The audio shifts into a high-energy advertising mode. The narrator's voice becomes significantly louder, faster, and more authoritative, displaying high arousal. Frequent 'ding' and 'pop' sound effects are used to punctuate the mention of various protein flavors and nutritional benefits. The BGM swells with added high-frequency energy. (4) Short incidental SFX of a spoon clicking against a tub and a swallowing sound are heard, layered over the rapid-fire commercial narration. The music's beat strength is prominent, matching the fast-paced editing rhythm. The signal remains exceptionally clean with a high harmonic-to-noise ratio. (5) The energy level subsides as the dialogue returns to the comedic game scenario. The BGM loops back to the initial playful theme. A final humorous line is delivered with a sarcastic, falling intonation before a clean silence ends the track.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Comedic Setup -> Absurd Transition -> Product Promotion -> Call-back Joke
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote 'Full Love Super Protein' drinks and yogurts by leveraging a popular children's game and the creator's signature multi-role comedic style. The video uses a relatable 'clueless/wooden' character archetype to transition into a high-energy sales pitch for nutritional supplements.
